title: Whipped Raspberry Water Ice
method: In a small saucepan, bring the sugar and measured water to the boil, then reduce the heat and allow to simmer for 3-5 minutes to fully dissolve the sugar.
Pour into a small heatproof bowl and leave to cool fully.

When the sugar syrup is cold, pour it into a food processor, add the frozen raspberries and blend for about 1 minute until fully puréed. Pour the egg whites in and whizz for about 1 minute — it will froth and just about double in size.
Serve as a soft-serve immediately, or pour into a 1-litre freezer-friendly container and freeze for 1-2 hours.
If freezing, remove from the freezer 10-20 minutes before serving to allow it to soften enough to scoop, or use a fork to rake it up granita-style.
notes: Try with 350g frozen mango and 1 passion fruit for a tropical-tasting dessert.
